Paper Identification.Title: Heat Transfer Enhancement in Channels With Turbulence Promoters
Paper Identification.Authors/Year: J. C. Han, J. S. Park, C. K. Lei / 1985
Paper Identification.Study Objective: To determine the effect of rib angle of attack and rib spacing on the pressure drop and average heat transfer coefficients in fully developed turbulent air flow in a square duct with two opposite rib roughened walls.
